shared_elements: rectangular decorated field on an upright slab
small repeated motifs arranged in rows/registers
justification: The only real correspondence is formal and generic: both are upright slab surfaces with framed fields containing repeated small motifs organised in horizontal registers or bands. A depicts a dense grid of blocky glyph-like signs with no animals or central figure, while B depicts a large radiating pinwheel disc ringed with dots and flanked by small profile quadrupeds between running wave/scroll borders — entirely different subject matter and drawing conventions (relief blocks of packed curvilinear signs versus thin silhouetted line drawing).
